caption:
Google gave Gemini a face. Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar streams real-time, lip-synced video conversations across 97 languages, watermarked with SynthID.

It's Gemini Enterprise only for now, not the free Gemini app. Save this for the full breakdown.

📷 Photo: Arthur Petron · CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

#gemini #google #deepmind #ai #aiavatar #aitools #genai

cover.headline: Google just gave Gemini a face. It can now hold a live, lip-synced video call with you:
cover.scene: A dark video-call screen glowing in a quiet room at night, a soft humanlike silhouette made of light particles mid-conversation, warm rim light on the edges, shallow depth of field, cinematic, no text, no logos, no real people
